skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Warm Velvet At the Corner
skins.content: Cambrian 1100 Winter New Arrivals/Warm Velvet At the Corner. A warm coat, both thick and lightweight, winter boots for icy, snow-laden roads, and a white knit cap complete with a bright bow. Proof you don't have to sacrifice warmth for cuteness.
skins.quote: Warmy trudges onwards and onwards, all so she can have the best bread in the neighborhood, though she ends up lost. Falling snow flutters through the night sky, and the scent of the bread in her hand cutting through the chilly air proves irresistible. Forget it, let's sit down and eat it while it's hot!
